description: This file defines the internal implementation of PersistentStreamPullingManager, a system target responsible for managing persistent stream pulling agents in Orleans streams. It handles queue management, agent lifecycle, notifications, and command execution within the stream provider infrastructure.

classes.name: PersistentStreamPullingManager
classes.description: Manages persistent stream pulling agents, handles queue assignment, rebalancing, lifecycle, and command execution within the Orleans stream infrastructure.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the manager, including setting up queue balancer and timers, and transitioning to the initialized state.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Shuts down all agents, cancels timers, and shuts down the queue balancer.

methods.name: StartAgents
methods.description: Starts all agents responsible for assigned queues.

methods.name: StopAgents
methods.description: Stops all agents responsible for queues, transitioning the manager state.

methods.name: QueueDistributionChangeNotification
methods.description: Handles incoming notifications about changes in queue distribution, serializing execution to avoid concurrency issues.

methods.name: HandleQueueDistributionChangeNotification
methods.description: Processes the change in queue distribution, adding or removing queues as needed.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes commands like starting or stopping agents, querying status, ensuring serialization.
